- Supported export formats and schemas (audit events, token-level traces, session metadata).

- SLA for a bulk export (we commonly ask for 1–3 TB exports for discovery).

Can you provide a short playbook we can include in our RFP response? Ideally: timelines, file-level manifest example, and any extra costs or staffing needs.

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Summary below (high-level playbook). I attached a formal PDF and a short checklist; Ben follows with the technical appendix and manifest sample.

High-level answers:
- Supported formats: NDJSON (preferred) and Parquet for bulk analytics. For token-level traces we provide NDJSON with event types: request_start, token_emit, model_variant, routing_decision.
- Snapshot cadence: Scheduled daily snapshots retained for 90 days by default; on-demand snapshots available (hot snapshot) with typical availability within 48 hours. We offer weekly rolling snapshots for up to 365 days under Dedicated/Private plans.
- Lookback window: Live system can export up to full retention (configurable per contract). Default retention tiers: 90d standard, 365d extended, custom multi-year on Private deployments.
- Tamper evidence: Export packages include a manifest (SHA256 checksums per file) signed by our HSM-backed key. We also provide signed timestamps and an integrity report (audit log of export operation).
- Redaction: Two modes — pre-export automated redaction (PII/PHI patterns with configurable rules) and post-export redaction helpers (tooling + sample scripts). Pre-export redaction is required for PHI-sensitive exports by default; it can be scoped to fields or full token suppression.
- Delivery channels: S3 presigned URLs (recommended), SFTP, HTTPS push to your endpoint, or direct S3-to-S3 transfer for customers with VPC endpoints. All transfers use TLS 1.2+ and data-at-rest AES-256.
- SLA and timeline: For standard customers, up to 500GB bulk export within 72 hours; up to 3TB is completed within 5 business days (we provide staged delivery). On-demand hot snapshots: 48 hours for delivery. For Dedicated/Private contracts we can negotiate tighter windows.

Next steps: Ben will add the manifest sample and technical handoff template. We can schedule a short 30-min call to walk your team through the playbook and a small sample export.

Subject: RE: RFP follow-up: evidence harvest window, export formats, tamper evidence — technical appendix

Elena —

Technical appendix and sample manifest below. Key points first:
- Manifest format: NDJSON lines where each line = {"path":"...","size":12345,"sha256":"...","event_count":...}. We include a top-level export metadata.json with timestamps, export_id, operator, and retention_policy.
- Signing: Manifest and metadata are signed with a PKCS#11 HSM key; we provide a detached signature (.sig) and also the SHA256 digest in plaintext. For higher assurance we can deliver an RFC 3161 timestamp token.
- Hashing and verification: We compute SHA256 for every exported file and provide a manifest you can run through a verification script. Sample verification script included in s3-handoff-template.txt.
- Redaction processing: Pre-export redaction runs through a deterministic token-mapping pipeline that replaces sensitive spans with reversible tokens only if requested; otherwise we provide irreversible redaction (recommended for PHI). Reversible token mapping uses a customer-scoped encryption key if you supply a KMS ARN (Private/Dedicated) or we can provision a transient key for the export.
- Performance and sizing: Typical export throughput is ~200–400 MB/min depending on instance size; for 3TB we stage delivery across multiple objects/keys and parallelize transfers.
- Retention-hold integration: We mark relevant export snapshots with legal_hold=true in export metadata and ensure they are retained beyond standard TTL until release.

Sample manifest line (NDJSON):
{"path":"exports/2026-11-27/requests-0001.ndjson","size":23548234,"sha256":"e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...","event_count":123456}

We attached: evidence_manifest_sample.ndjson and s3-handoff-template.txt (includes presigned URL usage, multipart upload guidance and verification commands).

If you want PGP-signed manifests instead of HSM signatures, we can accommodate that as an alternate delivery method.

Cheers,

Subject: RE: RFP follow-up: evidence harvest window, export formats, tamper evidence — final clarifications and suggested RFP wording

Elena —

Answers inline and suggested wording at the bottom.

1) Custom redaction rules: Yes. We support per-export redaction profiles supplied as JSON (regex rules, field-mapping, allowlist). We will validate rules in a sandbox export and provide a sample set before production runs. Customers may also supply a suppression list. For PHI exports we by default require irreversible redaction unless you request reversible tokenization and provide a customer KMS key.

2) 3TB SLA staging: Correct. For exports >500GB we stage delivery. Typical pattern: initial stage (roughly first 10–20% of objects) delivered within 48 hours to allow early inspection, remaining objects shipped in parallel and completed within 5 business days. Each stage includes a stage-level manifest; the top-level export metadata.json references all stage manifests and their digests.

3) Integrity verification over time: We retain public signing certificates and RFC 3161 timestamp tokens for 7 years by default; for multi-year preservation we can escrow signing keys / provide archived signed manifests as part of an enterprise retention add-on. Certificates and archived manifests are available on request under an escrow agreement.

Suggested RFP appendix wording (2–3 sentences):
"Redwood Inference provides NDJSON and Parquet bulk export formats with HSM-signed export manifests and per-file SHA256 digests. On-demand snapshots are available within 48 hours; bulk exports up to 3TB are completed within 5 business days with staged delivery and per-stage manifests. Pre-export redaction (configurable per-export) and encrypted transit (TLS) / rest (AES-256) are supported; long-term manifest archival and signing certificate escrow are available under enterprise agreements."

Next steps: If that wording works, we'll supply the exhibit (playbook + manifest sample) as a formal appendix for your RFP packet and draft a Statement of Work itemizing any add-on deliverables. I can set up a 30-min call Wednesday to review.

Thanks,
